## Notes

- time travel: chapter 8 uses the driver act closeday (REGISTER/CHECKIN pending arrivals, approve pending expense, settle open POS checks, NIGHT_POST, SHIFT_CLOSE, DAY_CLOSE, NEXT_DAY, SHIFT_OPEN through ctx.run) twice so Rahul can leave on 26 Oct; chapters 9+ run on 26 Oct 2026
- ch2 keys: encoder brought online by Meera in the Encoder tab (demo), card issued then lost-card re-issue
- feedback: revenue.feedback (guest feedback and QR) is shown as the star box in the check-out dialog (chapter 8) and the QR mention on the booking site preview (chapter 14); the build has no separate page
- crm: customers.crm: notes and preferences shown (Edit profile); tags and merge are not offered by the build (duplicates are only flagged), see TRAINING_NOTES F18
- payroll: people.payroll: September locked run and payslips; October cannot be run before the month ends (F16)
- hall quotations: revenue.quotations: quotation created, overridden, sent and accepted in chapter 15; revision and discount buttons are read, not clicked
- steps: 589 steps in 25 chapters (plan estimate about 460)
